data.name: Chinwe
data.gender_notes: Chinwe is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Chinwe is recorded in name-lists as “God's gift”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chinwe expresses “God's gift”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chinwe total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
